name: Charady: Party Charades
subtitle: Guess words with friends
description:
Act it out. Guess the word. Laugh together.

Charady is the ultimate forehead charades party game for friends and family. One player holds the phone up, everyone else gives clues, and you tilt to keep the round flying. Simple rules. Endless decks. Instant party energy.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Pick a deck that matches your vibe
2. Hold the phone to your forehead so friends can see the word
3. Friends act, describe, or mime — no saying the word
4. Tilt down for correct, tilt up to pass
5. Beat the clock and pass the phone to the next player

WHY CHARADY
• Classic forehead charades made for groups
• Dozens of themed decks — movies, animals, food, brands, and more
• Create custom decks for inside jokes and family nights
• Offline play — no Wi-Fi required for local games
• Quick rounds built for parties, road trips, and icebreakers
• Clean, family-friendly word packs

Perfect for game night, house parties, travel, and any room that needs more laughs. One phone. Whole group. Pure charades chaos.
